# Jakub Pešl, MBA

> European Marketing Communications Manager at Panasonic Marketing Europe. Builds and executes go-to-market communication across 20+ European markets — from master strategy agreed with global HQ in Japan to campaigns that land in each individual country. Based in Prague, CZ; hybrid from Wiesbaden, DE. 19 years at Panasonic.

## At a glance

- Level: manager — a European-scope marketing communications role combined with hands-on execution (not a director-level position)
- 19 years at Panasonic
- 20+ European markets; strategy cascaded to the marketing teams of the 6 main European offices
- Team: leads a local CEEG team of 5 (retail & trade marketing); works with 8–10 specialised agencies
- Fire TV campaign with Amazon ("Watch your favourites. Control your home."): 500M impressions in 6 European countries
- Strength: delivers large projects on relatively lean budgets (e.g. Technics TWS global events)
- 5+ global trade shows & events (CES, IFA and more)
- 20+ courses & certifications
- Languages: Czech (native), English (C1–C2), German (basic). Working language is English — including the DACH, Norway and Netherlands work
- Bronze Individual Award — top 3 of ~150 employees across 17 countries, Panasonic CEE
- Brands & stages: Panasonic, Technics, LUMIX, CES, IFA
- Core skills: European GTM, product marketing, campaign development, trade marketing, brand communication, P&L & budget ownership, agency management, team leadership

## Now (updated November 2026)

- At work: leading marketing for DACH, Norway and the Netherlands in detail, including P&L, and bringing in best practices from other European regions.
- Exploring: automation with AI agents and how it transforms work processes inside a large corporation.
- Building: his own apps — fascinated that these skills are now within everyone's reach (this website included).
- Listening & watching: travel, technology and investing.
- Off the clock: family time, regular sport and the occasional morning coffee with friends.
- Happy to talk about: AI agents in corporate marketing, European go-to-market, marketing in DACH, Norway & the Netherlands, trade shows & events, building apps with AI.

## Approach

Connects European strategy with local market execution: adapting a centrally built message so it still makes sense in each country, steering agencies, running retail and partner activity, owning the P&L behind it and keeping 20+ markets moving in the right direction.

Values: Fair Play (say what you'll do, then do it; long-term relationships with agencies, retailers and teams), Eyes on the Goal (budgets, deadlines and constant change treated as normal — answered with efficiency, impact and creativity), Growing People (building a team that can run things without him).

## Selected work

- **TV** — European GTM strategy for the TV lineup; partnerships with Activision Blizzard and Amazon (European communication later used globally); Fire TV campaign with Amazon reaching 500M impressions in 6 countries; gaming TV strategy activation across Europe; 200+ product videos a year for global use.
- **Technics** — Technics TWS European strategy and campaign activation (2023–2025); European communication for four generations of Technics true wireless earbuds (EAH-AZ60, AZ60M2, AZ80, AZ100); production team behind the Technics TWS global events (2023, 2024, 2025), delivered on a relatively lean budget; Czech activation with Ondřej Brzobohatý.
- **LUMIX** — LUMIX Stories, an influencer and ambassador programme built on authentic storytelling; creators also used for internal production.
- **Exhibitions & Events** — CES 2024 & CES 2025 project leader for the Consumer section; IFA Berlin category owner for the Panasonic hall (2020–2025); Range Review dealer events in Prague and Milan; TV lineup introduction events (2024, 2025).
- **P&L, Budget & ROI** — full ownership of the European multi-channel marketing budget incl. P&L setup; built the control system for marketing investment (ROI evaluation, reporting to senior management); agency cooperation optimisation (2024–present); CEEG merchandising team operations (2022–2023).
- **Audio** — Czech cooperation with the band Lake Malawi (Technics and party speakers); long-term partnership with Óčko TV.

## Career

- **Apr 2021 – present — European Marketing Communications Manager**, Panasonic Marketing Europe (Prague / Wiesbaden). Pan-European master strategy for marketing communication and the assets European markets run on; end-to-end European campaigns incl. P&L, budget and ROI; coordination with global HQ in Japan; support for national sales organisations (LSOs); CES & IFA; leads the marketing team with external agencies and suppliers.
- **2019 – Jan 2021 — Trade & Marketing Communications Manager**, Panasonic Marketing Europe GmbH, Czech Branch. Marketing communications, trade marketing and merchandising for the Czech market; Training & Promotion team; ATL/BTL campaigns across B2E, B2B and B2C; agency selection and management.
- **Apr 2011 – 2019 — Trade Marketing Manager**, Panasonic Marketing Europe GmbH, Czech Branch. Trade marketing, merchandising, Training & Promotion team; Regional Trade Marketing Manager for Eastern Europe (2011–2013); sales promotion plans, trainings, PR events, agency relationships, online trade systems, marketing budget.
- **Sep 2007 – Mar 2011 — Head of Call Centre**, Panasonic Marketing Europe GmbH, Czech Branch. Built and ran the in-house customer department for the Czech and Slovak markets.

## Education & learning

- **MBA, Marketing & PR** — British Business School (BBS), May 2024 – Jul 2025.
- Courses include: vibecodingformarketers.com (AI course), AI in Marketing, Communication Skills I–III, Communication Skills for Managers, People Leadership, Project Management, Storytelling with Insight, Merchandising & Instore Communication, Customer Relationship Development, Stress & Time Management.

## Beyond the office

Tech explorer (AI tools, consumer gadgets), active life (sport as a reset), family & travel across Europe. Motto: "Life is like LEGO — only when all the pieces fit together can the result be perfect. Work is one of those pieces."
